#

#
# 依赖：Telegram.app、辅助功能权限（终端 / Cursor / iTerm 需允许控制电脑）
# 输出：~/Desktop/CH/telegram/telegram_devices_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.png

set -euo pipefail

CAPTURE_ONLY=false
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--capture-only" ]]; then
  CAPTURE_ONLY=true
fi

TG_APP="${TELEGRAM_APP:-Telegram}"
OUT_DIR="${ONEHR_SCREENSHOT_DIR:-$HOME/Desktop/CH/telegram}"
mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"

timestamp="$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
outfile="$OUT_DIR/telegram_devices_${timestamp}.png"

if [[ ! -d "/Applications/${TG_APP}.app" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: 未找到 /Applications/${TG_APP}.app" >&2
  exit 1
fi

open -a "$TG_APP" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 0.8

NAV_APPLESCRIPT='
on clickDeviceManagement()
  tell application "System Events"
    tell process "Telegram"
      set frontmost to true
      -- 优先按侧栏文案点击（中/英 Telegram 均尝试）
      set targetNames to {"设备管理", "Active Sessions", "Devices"}
      repeat with targetName in targetNames
        repeat with w in windows
          try
            set hits to (every UI element of w whose name is targetName or name contains targetName)
            repeat with e in hits
              try
                click e
                return "clicked:" & targetName
              end try
            end repeat
          end try
          try
            set hits to (every static text of w whose value is targetName or value contains targetName)
            repeat with e in hits
              try
                click e
                return "clicked:" & targetName
              end try
            end repeat
          end try
        end repeat
      end repeat
      -- 兜底：old-mac 常见设置窗 ~1186x748，「设备管理」约在侧栏 58% 高度（勿用 440/1021，会点到隐私）
      set {wx, wy} to position of window 1
      set {ww, wh} to size of window 1
      set cx to wx + (ww * 120 / 1186)
      set cy to wy + (wh * 430 / 748)
      click at {cx, cy}
      return "fallback:120/1186,430/748"
    end tell
  end tell
end clickDeviceManagement

on windowBounds()
  tell application "System Events"
    tell process "Telegram"
      set frontmost to true
      set pos to position of window 1
      set sz to size of window 1
      return (item 1 of pos as text) & "," & (item 2 of pos as text) & "|" & (item 1 of sz as text) & "," & (item 2 of sz as text)
    end tell
  end tell
end windowBounds

tell application "Telegram" to activate
delay 0.4

if CAPTURE_ONLY then
  return my windowBounds()
end if

tell application "System Events"
  tell process "Telegram"
    set frontmost to true
    keystroke "," using command down
    delay 1.2
  end tell
end tell

set navResult to my clickDeviceManagement()
delay 1.0
return (my windowBounds()) & "|nav=" & navResult

  bounds="$(CAPTURE_ONLY=true osascript <<'APPLESCRIPT'
tell application "Telegram" to activate
delay 0.3
tell application "System Events"
  tell process "Telegram"
    set frontmost to true
    set pos to position of window 1
    set sz to size of window 1
    return (item 1 of pos as text) & "," & (item 2 of pos as text) & "|" & (item 1 of sz as text) & "," & (item 2 of sz as text)
  end tell
end tell
APPLESCRIPT
)"
  nav_info=""
else
  raw="$(osascript -e "$NAV_APPLESCRIPT" -e 'set CAPTURE_ONLY to false')"
  nav_info="${raw#*|nav=}"
  bounds="${raw%%|nav=*}"
fi

pos="${bounds%%|*}"
sz="${bounds#*|}"
x="${pos%,*}"
y="${pos#*,}"
w="${sz%,*}"
h="${sz#*,}"

if [[ -z "$x" || -z "$y" || -z "$w" || -z "$h" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: 无法读取 Telegram 窗口位置（检查辅助功能权限）" >&2
  exit 1

/usr/sbin/screencapture -x "-R${x},${y},${w},${h}" "$outfile"

if [[ ! -s "$outfile" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: 截图失败 $outfile" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "OK $outfile"
echo "  region: x=${x} y=${y} w=${w} h=${h}"
if [[ -n "${nav_info:-}" ]]; then
  echo "  navigate: ${nav_info}"
fi
